NQ. ES. YM. Three trades? No. ONE bet. 🎯

A trader goes long Nasdaq, S&P and Dow futures, risking 1% on each. It feels diversified, but the three indices move together: when the market sells off, all three stops get hit in the same candle. That's a 3% loss on one idea, three times the risk the plan allowed.

1️⃣ Check correlation before opening a second position
2️⃣ Highly correlated trades share the same risk budget
3️⃣ Split your 1% across them instead of stacking it
